description: The host half of the channel rooms and the issuer of every machine slot, on the public host. Member nodes' `channel` plugins call it through this host's door; sessions use `channel`.

functions.name: open
functions.description: Open a room at the tether relay with the member as its first member.

params.name: member
params.description: The session this call acts for: `session` (its R9 id), `name` and `level`.

functions.name: join
functions.description: Add the member to an open plain room.

params.name: member
params.description: The session this call acts for: `session` (its R9 id), `name` and `level`.

functions.name: write
functions.description: Send one message into a room the member is in.

params.name: member
params.description: The session this call acts for: `session` (its R9 id), `name` and `level`.

functions.name: close
functions.description: The member leaves the room; the last to leave ends it.

params.name: member
params.description: The session this call acts for: `session` (its R9 id), `name` and `level`.

functions.name: status
functions.description: The rooms the member is or was in.

params.name: member
params.description: The session this call acts for: `session` (its R9 id), `name` and `level`.

functions.name: feed
functions.description: What waits for the calling node's members, after their cursors. Renews the leases of the sessions in `live`.

functions.name: issue
functions.description: A machine-channel slot for the calling node's operator daemon: `{slot, token, expires_in}`. With `slot`, `token` and `owner`, put that held slot back on a relay that restarted: `{restored: true}` or `{refused: taken|ended}`.

functions.name: tether
functions.description: This host's tether relay: its release and child.
